sentence: This project uses mass spectrometry to study proteins and lipids in human tissues, human organoids, and mouse models to understand resilience in Alzheimer’s disease.
This project builds deep learning models that predict how antigens and antibodies bind to each other, using large sequencing data.
This project builds deep learning methods to analyze wearable device data and see how stress, sleep and physical activities relate to cancer risk factors.
This project studies the underlying mechanisms of vision and blinding diseases.
This project studies how animals keep their salt and water balance within and between tissues, using genetic screening and CRISPR gene editing.
This project studies how viruses cause human cancer and looks for ways to prevent and treat these cancers.
This project studies how prostate cancer cells resist treatment when a protein called neurolysin is missing and a motor protein is released.
This project tries to grow the malaria parasite Plasmodium vivax continuously in red blood cells using a custom-made bioreactor.
This project studies how to detect glaucoma that gets worse over time in people with high myopia, using deep learning.
This project builds tools that use DNA-encoded chemical libraries and enzyme activity probes for biological discovery.
This project studies how a protein made from the X chromosome controls gene expression in females and males.
This project uses Drosophila embryos to study how fibroblast growth factor proteins send signals in both directions during early heart development.
This project uses a rat model to study why some individuals are more vulnerable or resilient to opioid use disorder.
This project tries to develop small molecule inhibitors of a protein that drives prostate cancer.
This project studies how histone deacetylases modify proteins and how this helps cells adapt to nutrient stress.
This project studies how inherited genetic differences link clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential to coronary artery disease.
This project studies how a poorly characterized kinase regulates the activity of the motor protein Myosin 7A.
This project builds a test that measures HIV RNA in clinical samples using a CRISPR cascade signal amplification approach.
This project studies how Tet enzymes control gene expression in embryonic stem cells.
